summary.intent: Demo/simulate an incoming alert call for the ask-soony app, either via PWA push notification or a real Twilio phone call to GPT-Realtime, and get push notifications working on the user's phone.
summary.outcome: Presented two simulation options (PWA push vs. Twilio call). When the user reported no notification permission prompt, checked the server inbox log and fixed auth by exempting static PWA files from basic auth in src/ask_soony/basic_auth.py, then committed. Push setup was not yet re-verified on the phone.

repo: ask-soony exposes a CLI for alerts: `ASK_CALL_PROVIDER=openai uv run ask-soony alert raise --severity --impact --title --message --action`, which triggers a Twilio call to GPT-Realtime (~$0.38/min).
The app is served at ask-soony-app.stenglein.dev behind basic auth and is installed as a PWA; push alerts require Add to Home Screen and enabling alerts from within the installed app.
Server inbox log records PWA and push-key requests, useful for diagnosing how far the phone-side setup progressed.

code.finding: Basic auth was blocking static PWA files (likely manifest/service worker), which prevented the push permission prompt from appearing; these paths are now exempted from auth.

workflow: When a client-side flow silently fails, check server request logs to see how far it progressed before guessing at causes.
PWA service workers/manifests are fetched without credentials, so auth middleware must exempt them.

friction: User never saw the notification permission prompt on their phone; root cause was auth on static PWA files.
Push alerts require multi-step phone setup (Safari, Add to Home Screen, open from home screen), which is error-prone for a demo.
open_items: Re-test enabling call alerts on the phone after the auth fix and confirm a device subscribes.
Run the chosen simulation (test alert or real Twilio call) once alerts are on.
Wire automatic escalation from app push alert to real phone call if unanswered after X minutes.
Fix deployed? Confirm the committed basic_auth change is deployed to the live domain.
